entities.summary: Ignacy Julian Cejzyk(IPA: [iɡˈna.t͡sɘ ˈjuː.ljan ˈt͡sɛjzɨk] was a Polish artist and forger. He was the grandson of a Lithuanian military officer and was born in 1779 in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, in the city of Lyskovo, in the present day Belarus.
